installed_files.check_ip_https.go: build as /usr/local/bin/alumni-ip-https-check with CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64

backend_origin_rollout.method: Verified immutable backend artifact plus MOBILE_ORIGIN drop-in; backend-only restart with automatic rollback on failed checks.

notes: The hosting network lacks public-IP loopback; the server-side probe dials 127.0.0.1 but validates the public IP identity, CA chain, expiry and the served certificate fingerprint.
CentOS's legacy NSS curl rejects the short-lived certificate profile; the dedicated Go probe preserves full TLS verification instead of bypassing it.
The existing domain certificate and its Certbot job are unchanged.
The certificate and account private keys remain only on the server; never commit them.
To roll back the IP endpoint, disable this timer and remove only the two 00-alumni-ip vhost configurations, then run httpd -t and reload httpd. IP-based mobile clients would stop connecting.
Routine release deployment does not install or remove these independently managed files.

The IP-origin backend was deployed as a maintenance change so the existing account-erasure and retention gates remained unchanged. Its prior binary and receipt are in backend_origin_rollout. Do not use an older release's activation command against this newer binary; prepare a current release first.
